product_overview: SIGAPPA is a web platform for managing PKM proposal submissions, status tracking, and public activity mapping at Politeknik Pariwisata Makassar. It supports lecturer/staff registration and submission, admin review and data management, and a public map dashboard for community visibility.
core_goals: Let lecturers and staff register and submit PKM proposals digitally.
Let lecturers verify their NIP before creating or accessing an account.
Let users track the status of their own PKM submissions and related team involvement.
Let admins review, manage, and import PKM records and personnel data.
Show a public map-based view of PKM activity locations and basic details.

features.name: Welcome and Public Access
features.description: Visitors can open the public entry points to learn about SIGAPPA, access login and registration, and view the public PKM map dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See the SIGAPPA welcome page -> Choose to continue to public access or authentication
Navigate to /beranda -> See the public PKM map dashboard -> Review activity locations and basic activity information

features.name: Lecturer NIP Verification Login
features.description: Lecturers use their NIP to determine whether they should log in with an existing account or complete registration first.
user_flows: Navigate to /login/dosen -> Enter NIP -> Verify the NIP -> See the password login form if the account already exists -> Enter password -> Submit login -> See the user dashboard
Navigate to /login/dosen -> Enter NIP -> Verify the NIP -> See the registration form if the account does not exist -> Enter email and password -> Submit registration -> See the user dashboard
Navigate to /login/dosen -> Enter an unregistered NIP -> Verify the NIP -> See that the NIP is not recognized

features.name: User Registration and Login
features.description: New users can create an account with standard credentials, and existing users can access their account with email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter the requested registration details -> Submit registration -> See the account access flow complete
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login -> See the authenticated user area

features.name: Submission Status Tracking
features.description: Authenticated lecturers and staff can review PKM submissions they are involved in, including proposals they lead and proposals where they are listed as team members.
user_flows: Navigate to /cek-status -> View the list of related PKM proposals -> Review which items are linked as team leader or team member

features.name: New PKM Proposal Submission
features.description: Authenticated users can create and submit a new PKM proposal through the proposal form.
user_flows: Navigate to /pengajuan -> Fill in the PKM proposal form -> Submit the proposal -> See the submission recorded for review

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: P3M administrators can view the main statistical dashboard for monitoring PKM submission activity and overall progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> See summary statistics and activity charts -> Review current PKM progress

features.name: Historical PKM Import
features.description: Administrators can preview and import historical PKM data from an Excel file into the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/historis -> Select an Excel file containing PKM records -> Preview the parsed data -> Review the detected columns and matches -> Import the historical records -> See the import complete in the historical data area

features.name: PKM Submission Review
features.description: Administrators can view and review submitted PKM proposals for administrative processing.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/pengajuan -> See the list of PKM submissions -> Review the submission details -> Assess items for further processing

features.name: Lecturer and Staff Management
features.description: Administrators can manage lecturer and staff records in the employee database.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/pegawai -> See the list of employee records -> Add or update a lecturer or staff record -> Save the changes -> See the record reflected in the list

features.name: User Account Management
features.description: Administrators can manage registered user accounts in the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> See the list of user accounts -> Add, update, or remove an account -> Save the changes -> See the updated account list

routes.description: Public map dashboard showing PKM activities
Public login selector and standard credentials form
Specialized login portal for lecturers with NIP verification
User dashboard to track own submissions and correlation
Form to submit a new PKM proposal
Manual input and Excel importing for historical PKM data
List and review of all PKM submissions
CRUD management of lecturer and staff records

features.name: Lecturer NIP Verification Login
features.description: Lecturers verify their NIP first. If registered, they input password. If not, they complete registration.
user_interactions: Input NIP in NIP check field
Fill password or fill email/password to register

features.name: Historical PKM Import
features.description: Admin uploads spreadsheet to import past PKM records using smart name matching.
user_interactions: Select Excel file containing PKM list
Click import to submit and run database seeding

features.name: Submissions Correlation Check
features.description: Lecturers see all PKM they are involved in, whether as head of team or team member.
user_interactions: View list of proposals where user is Ketua Tim or Anggota Dosen
